processors.name: UpdateAttribute
processors.comments:
Added the following properties:
symbol - Extracts the symbol by trimming quotes ("BTCUSDT" becomes BTCUSDT)
startTime - Set to Jan 1 2022, unless it is already defined from the loop logic
endTime - Not set. Per the documentation when this is not set it will take all data up to the limit.
filename - Creates a unique filename consisting of the symbol and the timestamp (ex: BTCUSDT_20251211220000.json)

processors.name: UpdateAttribute

https://api.binance.us/api/v3/klines?symbol=${symbol}&interval=1d&startTime=${startTime}

processors.name: GenerateFlowFile
processors.comments:
Will run once a day (every 86400 seconds).
This could also be set up as a cron job but the advantage of using seconds is that it can be started at any time and will run again 24 hours later, rather than setting a fixed time in the cron job like 0 0 0 * * ? which will run at midnight every day. So if you start the process at 7am you have to wait until midnight to actually get any data.
